params.message:
Report source list: a held source keeps the address it was given, and the linked copy follows the list

A page that moved was held under its new address only, so a report that prints
the address the writer gave did not find it. The given address is kept beside
it. An address that turns out to be a page the list holds already teaches that
row the address instead of holding the page twice. Adding or taking off a
source remakes the outgoing copy of a report that has its file.

Portal: A report source whose page has moved is now found in the report's file, and the report's links follow the source list when it changes.
